rationale: The original short thesis relied on price holding below the 5-minute 9-EMA with persistent selling pressure toward session lows, yet price has now reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA ($27.36 vs $27.34). Over the past 20 minutes, downside momentum has failed to materialize—reaching only $27.27 (0.13% MFE) far above the $27.18 session low—and recent 1-minute bars show buyers stepping in on rising volume. With dynamic resistance broken and downside follow-through absent, closing early saves the remaining risk before the $27.42 invalidation level is hit.
